name: metamask-tooling
description: MetaMask recipe tooling: the mm-harness runner and the Perps recipe library. Each slot edits its tooling repository and proves changes on its own Mobile checkout, simulator and Metro port.
action_sheet:
metamask-tooling registered.
  Each slot needs its own Mobile fixture before live proof:
  1. git clone git@github.com:MetaMask/metamask-mobile.git <slot repo parent>/<mmh-mobile|mmrp-mobile>
  2. Run the slot actions: Install owned Mobile dependencies, Install Mobile dev client
  3. Copy fixtures/runtime/wallet-fixture.json.sample to wallet-fixture.json in the registered project, fill the approved testnet wallet, then run Apply approved testnet wallet fixture
  The pool env must define MM_HARNESS_PACKAGE_ROOT, METAMASK_PERPS_LIBRARY_ROOT, FARMSLOT_NODE22_BIN and MOBILE_NODE_BIN.
